fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: User-provided description of the deployment group.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The cloud location of the deployment group, currently restricted to 'global'.

fields.label: Mirroring Deployment Group ID
fields.help: The ID to use for the new deployment group, which will become the final component of the deployment group's resource name.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: The network that will be used for all child deployments, for example: 'projects/{project}/global/networks/{network}'.
